answer_1.quote: MediTOD supports all three subtasks in a TOD system - natural language understanding (NLU), policy learning (POL), and natural language generation (NLG). ... We model all three tasks as seq2seq learning and evaluate baselines in the supervised and in-context learning settings.
answer_1.outputs: generated doctor utterances (responses) for the NLG sub‑task
